title: Chinese AI models account for ~60% of token usage by US companies on OpenRouter, making restrictions harder to impose without disrupting US users and businesses (Nectar Gan/Bloomberg)
summary: Nectar Gan / Bloomberg: Chinese AI models account for ~60% of token usage by US companies on OpenRouter, making restrictions harder to impose without disrupting US users and businesses — The rapidly increasing global competitiveness of China's artificial intelligence models is ringing alarm bells in Washington …
